## 8. Interpretation limits

- Smali callsites establish reachable code paths, not runtime execution for every EPUB.
- Font CSS parsing, archive-resource resolution and Typeface use must be connected by matching registers/arguments before claiming embedded font support.
- !important is only confirmed if parser state and downstream masks/priority comparisons are traced; string presence alone is insufficient.
- Selector-weight names are not equated to CSS specificity without constants and dispatch semantics.
- No matches in a partial decode are not proof of absence.
